Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 10
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly synthesized the information retrieved in the previous step. In Step 9, the WebSurfer explicitly found that Nakkhatra Mangala was the "eldest son of Prince Kitiyakara Voralaksana". However, in Step 10, the Planner concluded that the paternal grandfather was "King Chulalongkorn (Rama V)". This is a factual error because Prince Kitiyakara Voralaksana was the son of King Chulalongkorn, making him the *paternal great-grandfather*, not the grandfather. The Planner failed to correctly map the generational hierarchy (Busba -> Nakkhatra Mangala -> Kitiyakara Voralaksana -> King Chulalongkorn) and skipped a generation in its final conclusion.
